title: Accounting and Tax Services for Pizzerias

rows.before: We incorporated under the Ontario Business Corporations Act, moved the equipment, inventory and goodwill across on a section 85 rollover, applied the $500,000 Small Business Deduction so active income is taxed near 12.2%, reclassified the drivers correctly using CRA's RC4110 factors, set up mileage records, and built clean cash and POS reporting.
rows.after: We incorporated under the Ontario Business Corporations Act, moved the equipment, inventory and goodwill across on a section 85 rollover, applied the $500,000 Small Business Deduction so active income is taxed near 11.2% (12.2% before July 1, 2026), reclassified the drivers correctly using CRA's RC4110 factors, set up mileage records, and built clean cash and POS reporting.
rows.note: Case-study result stated without a date as the current SBD-taxed rate; treated as current. If Sharad dates this engagement before July 1, 2026, switch to R3 (leave).

rows.before: Cut the combined tax bill materially at the 12.2% rate
rows.after: Cut the combined tax bill materially at the 11.2% rate
